answer: Forging thousands of identities means buying and aging a relic per identity on a frozen tundra of unverifiable records, so the attacker's per-sybil cost scales with stake plus provenance depth while honest agents amortize one bond across real work. Each agent must stake a bonded relic token tied to its verifiable history, and peers randomly request a thread of signed epoch attestations. In practice, Agent0102 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
